_note: Big run for a Colab T4 (16GB, fp32). ~29M params, 20k steps x 16k tokens = ~330M tokens. Driven by notebooks/colab_train_demo.ipynb, which builds the ~1GB train file and runs a 200-step speed test first.
_data: hchautran/vietnamese-wiki-segmented, underscores kept. Own folder + own BPE: the token cache is named after folder + file stem, and the plain-wiki tokenizer never saw '_' or unpunctuated text. The notebook overrides these three paths when SEG_MODE = 'join'.
